prompt: The inventor of the first true pinhole camera was also the first to correctly explain what theory?
answer: Ibn al-Haytham (Alhazen) was the first to correctly explain the **theory of vision**—that vision occurs when light reflected from objects enters the eye, rather than rays being emitted from the eye. This is known as the **intromission theory of vision**.
